name: upgradelens-monorepo
description: UpgradeLens - Upgrade Impact Verifier for Dependency Pull Requests

scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace=@upgradelens/contracts run build && npm --workspace=@upgradelens/analyzer run build && npm --workspace=@upgradelens/runner run build
scripts.build:apps: npm --workspace=@upgradelens/worker run build && npm --workspace=@upgradelens/api run build && npm --workspace=@upgradelens/web run build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "API,WORKER,WEB" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
